workflows.trigger_header:
name: Automatic production release

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Deployment rehearsal]
    branches: [main]
    types: [completed]

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'codex/production-cicd'
      - 'main'
  workflow_dispatch:

name: Deploy Production
run-name: Deploy ${{ inputs.pool_mode }} ${{ inputs.image_digest }} ${{ inputs.legacy_transition_sha256 || 'normal' }}

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      rehearsal_run_id:
        description: 'Successful authenticated deployment rehearsal run'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      image_digest:
        description: 'Exact image digest (sha256:<64 hex>) to deploy'
        required: true
        type: string
      expected_commit:
        description: 'Expected source commit (full 40 hex) of the image'
        required: true
        type: string
      pool_mode:
        description: 'Pool mode; pg03 requires verified release authority and exact paired identities'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: 'off'
        options: ['off', 'pg03']
      rc_run_id:
        description: 'Successful same-commit PG03 RC run (required for pg03)'
        type: string
        required: false
      legacy_transition_sha256:
        description: 'Optional legacy-retirement-v1 request SHA256; requires fresh root authentication and exact maintenance authority'
        type: string
        required: false
      release_stage:
        description: 'Controlled holds public ingress after deployment; Provider acceptance is deferred'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: commercial
        options: [commercial, controlled]
      controlled_rehearsal_run_id:
        description: 'Successful controlled rehearsal (required for controlled stage)'
        type: string
        required: false
      migration_compatible:
        description: 'Is the candidate migration backward-compatible with the previous image?'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: 'false'
        options:
          - 'false'
          - 'true'
      confirmation:
        description: 'Type DEPLOY_PRODUCTION, or DEPLOY_LEGACY_RETIREMENT_V1 for the separately reviewed transition'
        required: true
        type: string

name: Deployment rehearsal

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [PG03 reviewed main Gateway RC]
    branches: [main]
    types: [completed]
  # Operator-supplied evidence is bound to an RC manifest, which only exists
  # after the RC finished. The automatic trigger therefore always races the
  # evidence upload: it runs before an operator can bind the new identity, and
  # re-running it changes run_attempt, which the release control rejects.
  # This entry re-runs the identical gates for an already built RC without
  # producing a new artifact, so the evidence can be bound first.
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      rc_run_id:
        description: 'Completed successful Gateway RC run id to rehearse'
        required: true
        type: string
      pool_mode:
        description: 'Release mode; off does not authorize production deployment'
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: pg03
        options: ["off", "pg03"]
      release_stage:
        description: 'Controlled deployment keeps public traffic blocked until owner Provider acceptance'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: commercial
        options: [commercial, controlled]

name: Failed production recovery
run-name: Failed controlled recovery ${{ inputs.mode }} RC${{ inputs.assets_rc_run }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: choice
        required: true
        options: [rehearse, recover, restore]
      assets_rc_run:
        description: Successful reviewed-main RC for recovery assets
        type: string
        required: true
      rehearsal_run:
        description: Same-source successful recovery rehearsal; empty for rehearse
        type: string
        required: false
      confirmation:
        description: REHEARSE_FAILED_RECOVERY, RECOVER_FAILED_CONTROLLED, or RESTORE_FAILED_WEBSITE
        type: string
        required: true

name: GHCR Pull Rehearsal

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_audit_only:
        description: 'Read-only RC/evidence/deployment-record audit; no SSH, environment or rehearsal'
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: false
      audit_rc_run_id:
        description: 'Existing successful RC to audit; never builds or deploys'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: '39205228315'
      inspection_only:
        description: 'Read-only SSH/sudo/asset/Runtime verification; never pulls or deploys'
        required: true
        type: boolean
        default: true
      image_digest:
        description: 'Exact image digest (sha256:<64 hex>) to rehearse pulling'
        required: false
        type: string
      expected_commit:
        description: 'Expected source commit (full 40 hex) of the image'
        required: false
        type: string

name: PG03 isolated exact-image schema rehearsal

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

name: PG03 successor independent grant
run-name: PG03 grant ${{ inputs.request_sha256 }}

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      request_json:
        description: 'Exact canonical successor request; non-secret hashes and identities only'
        required: true
        type: string
      request_sha256:
        description: 'Exact SHA256 of canonical request_json, also identifies the frozen read-only approval activity'
        required: true
        type: string
      qualification_policy_sha256:
        description: 'Independently approved candidate qualification policy SHA256'
        required: true
        type: string

name: PG03 reviewed main Gateway RC

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [CI]
    branches: [main]
    types: [completed]

name: PG03 release state audit

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/pg03-predecessor-compat-20261019]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/release-state-audit.yml
      - scripts/ci/audit-release-state.py

conclusion: no push match for backup branch; no production trigger
